SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Agenda
Command that prints all events scheduled for a given date, in chronological order.
AppData
Singleton responsible for reading and writing calendar data in an XML file via JAXB.
Application
Main entry point of the calendar information system.
Book
Command that books (schedules) a new event in the currently opened calendar.
BusyDays
Command that prints workload statistics between two dates.
Calendar
Central calendar model - holds all scheduled events from the currently opened file.
Change
Command that modifies a single field of an existing event.
Close
Command that closes the currently opened calendar file without saving any changes.
Command
Enumeration describing all supported commands in the calendar information system.
CommandFactory
Factory that creates concrete Executable objects according to a given value of the Command enum.
CommandRunner
Utility class responsible for recognizing and executing textual commands entered by the user.
Event
Domain model for a single event (meeting) in the calendar.
Event.EventBuilder
Builder for Event objects.
Executable
Contract for any object that can be executed by the system.
Exit
Command that terminates the application.
FileHandler
Contract for an object that manages loading and saving data to/from a file.
Find
Command that searches for events whose name or note contains a given substring.
FindSlot
Command that finds the earliest free time slot of at least a given duration on a specific date.
FindSlot.Slot
Lightweight description of a free time slot in the calendar.
FindSlotWith
Command that finds a free slot common to two calendars (the current one and another one specified as a file).
Help
Command that prints the list of all supported commands and their descriptions.
Holiday
Command that marks a given date as a non-working day (holiday).
LocalDateAdapter
JAXB adapter that converts between an ISO-formatted string (YYYY-MM-DD) and a LocalDate.
LocalTimeAdapter
JAXB adapter that converts between an ISO-formatted string (HH:mm[:ss]) and a LocalTime.
Merge
Command that merges events from an external calendar file into the current calendar.
Open
Command that opens a calendar file and loads its contents.
Save
Command that writes the current calendar state back to the active file.
SaveAs
Command that writes the current calendar state to a new file specified by the user.
Unbook
Command that cancels (removes) an existing event from the calendar.
